Name: Satisfying Animals Petting - Benefits at Full Hearts
Author: ItsBenter
Description:
[color=#ff7700][size=3][b][img]https://i.imgur.com/WPCcaUs.png[/img]
[/b][/size][/color]Adding 11 configurable additional benefits when petting the animals at full hearts! Any of the features could be disabled and most values are configurable.

[quote][b]Pet's Affection[/b]
[center][img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/e/e9/Turtle.png[/img]﻿[img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/1/1e/Cat_1.png[/img]﻿[img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/a/a4/Dog_1.png[/img][/center]﻿
[list]
[*]Petting pets might give Pet's Affection buff (Max Stamina +30) for the day (10% chance).
[/list][/quote]
[quote][b]Golden Animal Cracker[/b]
[center][img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/c/c2/Golden_Animal_Cracker.png[/img]﻿﻿﻿[/center]
[list]
[*]After achieving Farming Mastery, petting farm animals (Barn and Coop) might drop Golden Animal Cracker (1% chance).
[/list][/quote]
[quote][b]Rabbit[/b]
﻿[center][img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/f/fd/Rabbit.png[/img][/center]
[list]
[*]Might drop additional iridium quality Rabbit's Foot (10% chance).
[*]Might give "Rabbit's Luck" buff (+1 luck) for the day (5% chance).
[/list][/quote]
[quote][b]Chicken[/b]
[center][img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/2/22/White_Chicken.png[/img][img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/f/fd/Brown_Chicken.png[/img][img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/6/61/Blue_Chicken.png[/img][img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/6/67/Void_Chicken.png[/img][img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/3/3c/Golden_Chicken.png[/img]﻿﻿﻿﻿[/center][list]
[*]Might drop Clay (30% chance).
[/list][/quote]
[quote][b]Void Chicken[/b]
[center][img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/6/67/Void_Chicken.png[/img][/center]
[list]
[*]Might drop Void Essence (5% chance).
[/list][/quote]
[quote][b]Dinosaur[/b]
[center][img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/8/89/Dinosaur.png[/img][/center][list]
[*]Might drop Geode, Frozen Geode, Magma Geode, or Omni Geode (40% chance).
[/list][/quote]
[quote][b]Pig[/b]
[center][img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/3/30/Pig.png[/img][/center][list]
[*]Might drop iridium quality Truffle (5% chance).
[/list][/quote]
[quote][b]Goat[/b]
[center][img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/5/52/Goat.png[/img][/center][list]
[*]Might drop Tree Fertilizer (25% chance).
[/list][/quote]
[quote][b]Ostrich[/b]
[center][img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/a/ad/Ostrich.png[/img][/center][list]
[*]Might drop 3-7 Clay (15% chance).
[*]Might give "Ostrich Nimble" buff (+1 speed) for the day (5% chance)
[/list][/quote]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/CqcVhaz.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Would this mod work with other modded pets and farm animals?
Yes, Pet's Affection buff and Golden Animal Cracker features would apply but there's no additional benefit from petting them. With the exception of mods that has effect added in this mod. There are:[/list]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿ (Including [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34843]Camelus[/url]﻿)
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9600]Lumisteria Visit Mount Vapius[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36573]Appaloosa Horses[/url]﻿﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36681]Waterside Flamingos[/url]﻿

[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35935]Woolly Goat[/url]﻿

[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25134][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8515]birdb's Goose[/url]
